items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: He had a scholar, he had a fellow by the name of Tony Gardina.

ctx.x: I've met quite a few of his pupils, your brother's pupils up there. People like Darnell Howard studied with him. Yeah. Older Simeon, who was born here, he died last year. Older Simeon, but he was one of the better clarinetists up there. He studied with your brother too.
He turned out a pretty fine little scholar too. And then I tell you, he had a scholar, he had a fellow by the name of Tony Gardina. Oh yes. Gardina.
He was the pupil of your brother's.
